summary: Backend verification for new POST /api/admin/integrations/s3-test endpoint + AWS S3 diagnostic + regression on /admin/settings and /media/upload. 7/7 pytest cases passed.
critical_code_review_comments: storage_service._sync_test_connection: public URL GET step uses urllib without a redirect/failure branch that distinguishes 403 from network errors — but the current friendly detail message is acceptable.
admin_controller.py is >1300 lines; consider splitting per module (settings/partners/merchants/bookings) for maintainability. Not blocking.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_s3_integration.py covers: auth (401 without token), saved-creds diagnostic (ok=true, public=false, 4 steps incl 'Public URL reachable' ok=false with public_url present), invalid override creds (ok=false + friendly error + 'Connect to bucket' ok=false), settings GET returns integrations.aws_*, PUT settings with partial integrations preserves sibling keys, media/upload with tiny PNG returns http URL. All 7 pass in ~8s.

verified_behaviour.s3_test_saved: ok=true, public=false, public_url returned, steps include Connect/Upload/Public URL reachable(ok=false)/Cleanup
verified_behaviour.s3_test_invalid: ok=false, error string set, Connect to bucket step ok=false
verified_behaviour.media_upload: returns http URL (S3 or local fallback), no 500 even with public step failing
